label: kedi: run $ZED_FILENAME
args: home=$KEDI_HOME; [ -n "$home" ] || home=$HOME/.kedi; if command -v kedi >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec kedi "$@"; fi; exec "$home/editor-venv/bin/python" -m kedi "$@"

label: kedi: eval $ZED_FILENAME
